name: sidebar-03
title: Sidebar 03
description: A sidebar with submenus: every section is a bold row with its pages listed underneath, hung on a pencil line down the margin. Mirrors shadcn's sidebar-03. Looks right on the desk and on plain paper.

files.content: import * as React from "react" import { SidebarBrand } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-brand" import { docsNav } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data" import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarGroup, SidebarHeader, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarMenuSub, SidebarMenuSubButton, SidebarMenuSubItem, SidebarRail, } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" export function AppSidebar({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps) { return ( {docsNav.map((section) => ( {section.title} {section.items.length ? ( {section.items.map((item) => ( {item.title} ))} ) : null} ))} ) }

import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-03/components/sidebar-03-app-sidebar"
import { containedClasses } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-contained"
import { docsTrail } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data"
import { PageBody, PageHeader, PageNote, PageSheet } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-page"
import { SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"

export default function Page({ contained = false }: { contained?: boolean }) {
  const c = containedClasses(contained)
  return (
    <SidebarProvider className={c.provider}>
      <AppSidebar className={c.sidebar} />
      <PageSheet className={c.inset}>
        <PageHeader crumbs={docsTrail} bordered className="overflow-x-clip" />
        <PageBody title="Margins" kicker="Writing on paper">
          <PageNote title="Nothing here yet" pose="peek">
            This page is still blank. The pad has every page, indented the way an outline is.
          </PageNote>
        </PageBody>
      </PageSheet>
    </SidebarProvider>
  )
}
